name: 50327 · Pleasant Hill, IA
findings: ZIP 50327 (Pleasant Hill) has 43 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (23%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 50327 (Pleasant Hill) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 50327 (Pleasant Hill) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 52% of the typical level).
